plan.tagline: One stage, many instruments, and a brighter future for young musicians.

plan.date_window: October, with a Saturday evening preferred
plan.taste_summary: These supporters enjoy Music and Music education, with School of Rock reinforcing their interest in music-focused entertainment. The program pairs guitar-driven performance with a practical celebration of young people learning instruments.
